description:
Moku is a fast, minimal manga reader frontend for Suwayomi-Server.


Moku is a fast, minimal manga reader frontend for Suwayomi-Server.

It wraps Suwayomi's GraphQL API in a lightweight Tauri app — no Electron overhead.
# Moku v0.11.5
**Released:** September 5, 2026
> "Bug, Cache, Bug, Bug, Break."

## New Features
• Added anime player upscaling (work in progress, untested)
• Added a Solid UI toggle
• Added Nix Cachix support for faster builds (#60)
• Added extension notes and onboarding fixes

## Improvements
• Increased timeout on Tsunagu kill to prevent premature termination
• Updated README with Cachix instructions (#60)

## Bug Fixes
• Fixed the bookmarking overlay and bookmark system
• Fixed the issue with extensions not being able to update.

## Notes
• Anime player upscaling is untested, expect issues
• Auth is still under active development

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/moku-project/Moku/compare/v0.11.0...v0.11.5
